summary: Initial independent review of all 229 Chinese units, four temporal or active-hint items, and Yang Daoquan. The only recorded personal chronology is a petition dated merely “during Mingchang.” The extraction incorrectly converts that indeterminate reign-period phrase into a full AD 1190–1195 activity interval and hint. No other named individual or omitted personal life date appears in the ritual-treatise units. Repair is required before fresh audit.

findings.problem: The source phrase 明昌間 gives only an indeterminate reign-period setting for Yang Daoquan’s petition. The existing claims and hint turn that setting into a full five-year personal activity interval, an unsupported endpoint inference.
findings.action: Replace the false AD 1190–1195 interval and active-date hint with a source-specific unresolved Mingchang-period context, or otherwise retain only chronology justified by the Chinese wording; then submit a sealed repair candidate for independent review.
